schema.title: Response Handle List Goals Goals Get

get.description: Return one goal with its progress.

patch.description: Change any of a goal's fields.

delete.description: Delete a goal and, by cascade, its tasks.

post.description: Create a task with its steps, optionally under one of the user's goals.

get.description:
List tasks a page at a time, with optional filters.

`view` picks one Tasks-page view (see `TaskView`). Open tasks come
soonest due first (Someday last); finished ones most recently completed
first. `someday=true` lists only undated tasks, `someday=false` only
dated ones; `no_goal=true` only goal-less ones.

schema.title: Response Handle List Tasks Tasks Get

get.description: How many tasks are in each view, for the same goal filters.

patch.description: Change a task; moving it requires owning the destination goal.

post.description: Add a step to the end of a task.

put.description: Put the task's steps in the given order; every step must be listed once.

patch.description: Rename a step or tick it off. Ticking never completes the task itself.

delete.description: Remove a step. A task always keeps at least one.

post.description: Move an open task later or to Someday; get a fix for the reason given.

get.description: A task's postponement history, oldest first.

schema.title: Response Handle List Postponements Tasks  Task Id  Postponements Get

post.description: Create a routine, optionally under one of the user's goals.

get.description: List routines by title; `active_on` keeps those running on that day.

get.description: Routines due on `on` (default: today, in the user's timezone).

schema.title: Response Handle List Due Routines Routines Due Get

patch.description: Change a routine. Switching frequency drops details it no longer uses.

delete.description: Delete a routine and its history.

put.description: Tick a routine off for `day`. Ticking twice is harmless.

get.description: The day's Top 3 tasks and, separately, its routines.

put.description:
Replace the day's Top 3 with `task_ids`, most important first.

Only open tasks can join the Top 3; tasks finished while already in it
may stay. Past days cannot be re-planned.

schema.title: Response Handle List Notifications Notifications Get

post.description:
Create any notifications now due, then return the unread count.

Clients call this when the app opens. Repeating it is harmless: each
event is notified once.

get.description: How many notifications are unread, for the bell's badge.

post.description: Mark one notification as read. Marking it again changes nothing.
Mark every unread notification as read.

TaskView.title: TaskView
TaskView.description:
Where a task appears on the Tasks page; each task is in exactly one.

- review: open, and either every step is done or the due date has passed
- scheduled: open, dated today or later, with steps left
- someday: open, undated, with steps left
- done: completed
